name: Simun the Quiet
description: A person who locked his precious thoughts in a chest and forgot where he hid the key.

description_citations.text: Magic 2011: card flavor text (Magic 2011, 2010), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Simun the Quiet locks his precious thoughts in a chest, then paranoidly locks away the memory of where he hid the key.
timeline.quote: Simun the Quiet filled the chest with his most precious thoughts.

citation.text: Sorcerer's Strongbox (Magic 2011, 2010), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
